Yes, a watering can counts as a non-living item, so it can be returned within 30 days of delivery if it's unused and in its original packaging. You're at about two weeks, so you're within the window.

1. Start the return from "My Orders". A prepaid label will be emailed to you, and it expires after 7 days, so drop the parcel off within that time.
2. A change-of-mind return costs a flat $6.95, deducted from your refund (free for Leafy Plus members). It's free if the item is faulty or we sent the wrong one.
3. Your refund goes to your original payment method within 5 business days of the parcel reaching our warehouse. Original shipping isn't refunded unless the whole order is returned because of our error.

There are no direct exchanges. If you'd like a different item, return this one and place a new order.
